born: {name} is born, and joins the family.
cloneJoined: {parent} divides. {name} takes up a place in the party.
cloneFollows: {parent} divides. There is no room in the party, so {name} follows behind.

training.started: {name} begins training as a {className}. About {days} days of travelling together should do it.
training.readyNoRoom: {name} has finished its training, but there is no room in the party for it yet.
training.graduated: {name} finishes training and joins the party as a {className}.

designedJoined: {name} takes up a place in the party.
